checks.name: a fresh form starts 未修改
typing marks the form 未保存（dirty）
dirty does NOT write to the service
leaving with an unsaved draft and returning RESTORES it
the restoration is DISCLOSED, not silent

detail.note: 已恢复上次未保存的草稿：新建简报。草稿仅保存在本机；保存成功或丢弃后即清除。

checks.name: a restored draft still reads as 未保存（dirty）
recovery itself wrote nothing to the service
after the service confirms, the state is 已保存（saved）
the save really hit the service exactly once
a successful save CLEARS the draft
a STALE_REVISION is labelled 冲突（conflict·可恢复）, not a generic failure
the conflict message explains the recovery (continue from the newest version)

detail.conflictStatus: 该版本已被取代，服务端拒绝了这次修订（STALE_REVISION）。请从版本链里的最新版本继续。

checks.name: console errors are limited to the deliberate 409 conflict probe

console_errors.text: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 409 (Conflict)

vocab_cross_check.name: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN is 待审, NOT 失败
every ALLOWED attempt state is classified
no invented states beyond the service vocabulary
